name: anti-slop
description: Rules for an AI coding agent to filter out generic AI-generated UI designs, text, and code.
readme_summary: Anti Slop provides a set of rules designed to filter out generic, uninspired content generated by AI coding agents. It acts as a pre-processing layer to ensure that AI-generated UI, copy, and code are not only functional but also avoid common AI pitfalls like filler text, fake data, and overly generic design elements. The goal is to produce cleaner, more directed, and less 'slop-filled' output from AI coding tools.
key_features: Acts as a filter, not a style guide
primary_use_case: To enhance the quality and originality of AI-generated code, UI, and copy by filtering out common AI-generated 'slop'.
cover_image_prompt: A meticulous artisan, wearing a clean apron and holding a fine-toothed comb, carefully sifting through a pile of generic, mass-produced widgets. The artisan is discarding the identical, bland widgets and selecting only the unique, well-crafted ones. Subtle digital particles representing AI code flow into the scene, some being caught by a fine mesh filter held by the artisan, while others pass through. The background is a clean, modern workshop with soft, focused lighting. The repository name 'Anti Slop' is subtly etched onto the artisan's comb. The image should be in a 3D isometric illustration style, emphasizing clarity and the act of refinement.

name: clearcam
description: Add object detection, tracking, mobile notifications, and search to any security camera.
readme_summary: Clearcam enhances any security camera by adding object detection, tracking, mobile notifications, and search capabilities. It processes RTSP streams to identify specific events, provides AI-powered summaries of notifications, and offers a self-hosted NVR solution with a companion iOS app.
key_features: AI Notification Summaries with Qwen3 VL
primary_use_case: To add intelligent features like object detection, real-time alerts, and searchable recordings to existing or new security camera systems.
cover_image_prompt: A vigilant digital owl perched atop a security camera, its eyes glowing with AI intelligence, scanning a live video feed projected onto a holographic screen. The owl is transforming raw video streams (represented by tangled wires) into clear, distinct icons of detected objects (like people, cars, or animals) and highlighting specific 'event' moments with glowing markers. Subtle code snippets and data visualizations float around the scene, with the 'Clearcam' logo subtly integrated into the camera's casing. The overall mood is one of enhanced security and intelligent surveillance. Style: 3D isometric illustration with a futuristic, clean aesthetic and a color palette of blues, greens, and subtle oranges.

name: reactjs-interview-questions
description: List of top 500 ReactJS Interview Questions & Answers....Coding exercise questions are coming soon!!
readme_summary: This repository serves as a comprehensive collection of ReactJS interview questions and answers, designed to aid developers in their preparation for technical interviews. It covers core React concepts, common interview scenarios, and related technologies.
key_features: Extensive list of ReactJS interview questions
Includes related technologies like React Router and Redux
Aims to assist in interview preparation
cover_image_prompt: A wise old librarian meticulously organizing a vast library of glowing books, each representing a ReactJS concept. The librarian is handing a perfectly organized stack of these 'concept books' to a eager student, who is holding a 'job offer' scroll. The library shelves are subtly lined with monitors displaying code snippets and UI elements. The overall mood is one of knowledge transfer and career advancement, with a warm, inviting atmosphere. The style should be a 3D isometric illustration with clear, friendly characters and a clean, organized composition, emphasizing the repository's role in structuring and delivering essential interview knowledge.

name: revanced-manager
description: 💊 Application to use ReVanced on Android
readme_summary: ReVanced Manager is an Android application designed to patch existing Android applications with modifications provided by the ReVanced project. It simplifies the process of downloading target apps, applying custom patches, and managing these modifications.
key_features: Select and apply patches to Android apps
Manage patches, apps, signing, themes, and settings
primary_use_case: To provide an easy-to-use Android application for patching other Android applications with ReVanced modifications.
cover_image_prompt: A skilled artisan in a workshop, holding a special tool that looks like a digital wrench and screwdriver. They are carefully modifying a generic smartphone app icon, transforming it from a plain version into a more enhanced, feature-rich version with glowing highlights. Input is represented by a stack of app boxes, and the output is a single, enhanced app box with a subtle digital aura. Small, stylized UI elements showing patch selection and progress are visible on a workbench nearby. The scene is brightly lit with a clean, modern aesthetic. The overall style should be a 3D isometric illustration with clear, friendly visuals, emphasizing the transformation and enhancement process.
